content.flowSummary: A new sender registers, exchanges the implementation guide, submits test messages, has rejections reviewed and is promoted to production.

delaySources.description: Test messages wait for a manual review of rejections.
The sender rebuilds its interface after each implementation guide change.
Rule changes are agreed in a meeting that is held rarely.

unknowns: How many rejections repeat after a fix.
content.suggestedNextStep: Collect one month of scrubbed rejection logs and group them by rule.
